instruction: Sync this video's playback speed in VLC to match the tempo of the music currently playing in my room.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent analyzed VLC state (open with no video playing), reasoned that VLC cannot automatically adjust brightness/contrast based on room lighting because it lacks ambient light sensor hardware integration. Correctly declared [INFEASIBLE] in 2 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can launch and analyze VLC interface, reason about software capability limitations, identify missing hardware/software requirements, correctly declare infeasible tasks
metadata.task_rationale: Tests whether model can identify that VLC cannot detect ambient room audio to sync playback speed. Similar to original task's pattern of requiring external sensor data (microphone + audio analysis) that VLC has no integration for. Requires multi-step reasoning: no video loaded AND no room audio detection capability.
metadata.explanation: VLC cannot detect or analyze audio playing in the user's physical room environment. While VLC can adjust playback speed manually, it has no capability to listen to ambient room audio via microphone, analyze its tempo, and sync playback accordingly. This requires external hardware (microphone) and software (audio tempo analysis + VLC integration) that don't exist. The agent must declare this infeasible. Uses the standard 'infeasible' evaluator.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible: VLC has no capability to detect ambient room audio via microphone, analyze its tempo, or automatically sync playback speed
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the appropriate choice for this task — no getter/metric combination could verify completion of an impossible task
Multiple valid reasons for infeasibility: no microphone integration in VLC, no audio tempo analysis capability, no automatic playback speed sync based on external audio
Coverage is complete — a single infeasible verdict fully addresses the verification requirement
